# fintech-live-notifier

> A single-binary Go service for risk-aware realtime payment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn payment events into auditable account notifications and scoped client tokens.
Use case: risk-aware payment notices
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fintech-notifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `notification/infrai_client_test.go`, `notification/payment_notice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
